name: Zen Washi & Sumi (和纸与松烟墨)
description: A tranquil, eye-friendly East Asian ink & paper aesthetic for Zen Browser. Soft Torinoko washi paper tones for light mode, deep pine-soot ink for dark mode, paired with organic mineral accents and optional Blended Addressbar integration.
author: db

js/tab-close.uc.js.name: Washi tab close animation
js/tab-close.uc.js.description: WAAPI close timeline, margin-based space collapse, batch guard and close-triggered switch downgrade.

js/tab-indicator.uc.js.name: Washi tab ink indicator
js/tab-indicator.uc.js.description: Transient lead/trail ink stroke during vertical tab switches (opt-in, zenwashi.tab.indicator).

js/floating-urlbar-center.uc.js.name: Washi floating URL bar centering
js/floating-urlbar-center.uc.js.description: Centers the Cmd+T / Cmd+L floating URL bar on the content area (right of the sidebar) instead of the whole window.
